words.enDefinition: an arrangement with a bank for holding and managing money

examples.en: I needed a local bank account before the university could record my payment details.
examples.zh: 学校要登记我的收款资料，我得先有一个当地的「银行账户」。

examples.en: My bank account still showed my old address after I moved closer to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到离学校更近的地方后，我的「银行账户」上仍显示旧地址。

words.enDefinition: to set up a new account with a bank

examples.en: I asked which documents I needed to open a bank account after moving to town.
examples.zh: 我刚搬到这座城市，就问「开立银行账户」要出示哪些材料。

examples.en: My flatmate waited while I went into the branch to open a bank account.
examples.zh: 我进网点「开立银行账户」时，室友在外面等我。

collocations: apply to open a bank account
open a bank account in person

words.enDefinition: a document requesting details needed to open an account

examples.en: The teller noticed that I had left one line blank on the account opening form.
examples.zh: 柜员发现我的「开户表」上有一行没填。

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my name before submitting the account opening form online.
examples.zh: 我先核对了姓名的拼写，再在网上提交「开户表」。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting to go through the account opening process

examples.en: I moved my account opening appointment to Friday because it clashed with my first seminar.
examples.zh: 「开户预约」和第一节研讨课冲突，我就把它改到星期五。

examples.en: The bank sent a map showing where to go for my account opening appointment.
examples.zh: 银行发来一张地图，标出了「开户预约」当天该去哪里。

words.enDefinition: an office of a bank serving the surrounding area

examples.en: My local branch moved across town during my first semester at the university.
examples.zh: 在我读大学的第一学期，「附近的银行网点」搬到了城另一头。

examples.en: I stopped by the local branch to ask about the statement I had received.
examples.zh: 我顺路去了「附近的银行网点」，问收到的那份账单是什么情况。

words.enDefinition: the bank branch officially associated with a customer's account

examples.en: I asked whether the home branch would change when I moved for my placement.
examples.zh: 我问搬去实习地以后，「账户归属网点」会不会变。

examples.en: The statement listed my home branch even though I usually used the university branch.
examples.zh: 虽然我平常去大学附近的网点，账单上仍列出了「账户归属网点」。

words.enDefinition: a bank employee who assists customers at a counter

examples.en: The bank teller asked how to spell my surname before looking up my account.
examples.zh: 「银行柜员」先问我的姓怎么拼，再查我的账户。

examples.en: I showed the bank teller the email with the appointment time and branch address.
examples.zh: 我给「银行柜员」看了那封写着预约时间和网点地址的邮件。

words.enDefinition: the service counter inside a branch of a bank

examples.en: I went to the branch counter after the receptionist checked the time of my appointment.
examples.zh: 接待人员核对预约时间后，我去了「网点柜台」。

examples.en: The bank sent me back to the branch counter to pick up my original documents.
examples.zh: 银行让我回「网点柜台」取回证件原件。

collocations: present a document at the branch counter

words.enDefinition: a bank employee who helps individuals with account services

examples.en: The personal banker asked what I meant by a separate account for my savings.
examples.zh: 「个人银行业务专员」问我所说的另开账户存钱是什么意思。

examples.en: I showed the personal banker the letter that the university had sent me last week.
examples.zh: 我给「个人银行业务专员」看了学校上周寄给我的信。

words.enDefinition: an organization that provides banking or other financial services

examples.en: The application asked for the name of the financial institution where my account was held.
examples.zh: 申请表要求我填上开户的「金融机构」名称。

examples.en: I called the financial institution listed at the top of my account opening letter.
examples.zh: 我打电话给开户信函顶端列出的「金融机构」。

collocations: open an account with a financial institution

words.enDefinition: a financial institution owned by its members

examples.en: The campus credit union sent me a link to its account opening form.
examples.zh: 校园的「信用合作社」发给我一个链接，指向它的开户表。

examples.en: I asked a friend whether the credit union had a branch near the new library.
examples.zh: 我问朋友，「信用合作社」在新图书馆附近有没有网点。

collocations: open an account with a credit union

words.enDefinition: a UK member-owned institution offering savings and home loans

examples.en: The building society had an office beside the bus stop I used for lectures.
examples.zh: 「英国住房互助协会」的营业点就在我平时坐车去上课的公交站旁。

examples.en: I read the leaflet from the building society while waiting to meet my flatmate.
examples.zh: 我等室友时看了「英国住房互助协会」的宣传折页。

words.enDefinition: a bank serving customers online without regular branches

examples.en: The online-only bank sent a message explaining how to check my application status.
examples.zh: 「纯线上银行」发消息说明了怎么查我的申请进度。

examples.en: I asked the online-only bank which department could correct a mistake in my profile.
examples.zh: 我问「纯线上银行」哪个部门可以更正我账户资料里的错误。

collocations: open an account with an online-only bank
an account from an online-only bank

words.enDefinition: a bank principally serving a local geographic area

examples.en: I took my university letter to the community bank across from the station.
examples.zh: 我带着学校的信去了车站对面那家「社区银行」。

examples.en: The community bank posted its holiday hours on the door before the semester ended.
examples.zh: 学期结束前，「社区银行」把假期营业时间贴到了门上。

collocations: an account at a community bank

words.enDefinition: a bank account designed for people enrolled as students

examples.en: The university adviser explained what a student bank account was during the welcome session.
examples.zh: 迎新说明会上，学校顾问解释了什么是「学生银行账户」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bank would update my student bank account after my graduation.
examples.zh: 我问银行毕业后会不会调整我的「学生银行账户」。

collocations: apply for a student bank account
the terms of a student bank account

words.enDefinition: an account designed for students studying outside their home country

examples.en: The bank sent me a document about its international student account before I arrived.
examples.zh: 我还没到学校，银行就发来了介绍「国际学生账户」的资料。

examples.en: I checked the eligibility information for an international student account on the bank's website.
examples.zh: 我在银行网站查了「国际学生账户」的申请条件。

collocations: ask about an international student account
apply for an international student account
requirements for an international student account

words.enDefinition: an account used for everyday deposits and payments

examples.en: I linked my checking account to the university's payment portal after confirming my details.
examples.zh: 确认账户资料后，我把「日常结算账户」关联到了学校的付款平台。

examples.en: The branch gave me a checklist for opening a checking account near my college.
examples.zh: 学校附近的网点给了我一份开立「日常结算账户」的材料清单。

words.enDefinition: where the money paid into an account comes from

examples.en: The form asked about the source of funds before I reached the final page.
examples.zh: 填到最后一页之前，表格问了我的「资金来源」。

examples.en: The teller asked whether the source of funds could be documented with my scholarship letter.
examples.zh: 柜员问能不能用我的奖学金通知来证明「资金来源」。

collocations: a document showing the source of funds

words.enDefinition: an account offering a limited set of banking services

examples.en: The adviser explained how a basic bank account differed from the bank's other accounts.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「基础银行账户」与这家银行其他账户有什么区别。

examples.en: I asked what documents the branch accepted for a basic bank account after moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我问网点申请「基础银行账户」可以用哪些材料。

collocations: apply for a basic bank account
qualify for a basic bank account

words.enDefinition: in this context, a bank account with no regular maintenance fee

examples.en: The branch listed a fee-free account next to its standard account options for students.
examples.zh: 网点在标准学生账户选项旁列出了一款「免管理费账户」。

examples.en: I asked which services were included in the fee-free account described in the booklet.
examples.zh: 我问小册子里的「免管理费账户」包含哪些服务。

collocations: compare a fee-free account with another option

words.enDefinition: a bank account held by two or more people

examples.en: My sister and I discussed opening a joint account for the bills we share.
examples.zh: 我和姐姐讨论过开个「联名账户」，用来处理我们共同承担的账单。

examples.en: I asked the bank which names would appear on a statement for a joint account.
examples.zh: 我问银行，「联名账户」的账单上会显示哪些人的姓名。

words.enDefinition: a bank account held in one person's name only

examples.en: The form asked whether I wanted a sole account or one shared with another person.
examples.zh: 表格问我想开「单人账户」，还是跟别人共用一个账户。

examples.en: I checked which address the bank had listed for my sole account after moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我查了银行在我的「单人账户」上登记的是哪个地址。

collocations: a sole account in your name

words.enDefinition: someone in whose name a bank account is held

examples.en: The university form asked for the name of the account holder, not the bank.
examples.zh: 学校表格要求填「账户持有人」姓名，不是银行名称。

examples.en: The teller asked the account holder to check the spelling before sending the letter.
examples.zh: 柜员请「账户持有人」先核对姓名拼写，再发出信件。

words.enDefinition: the person listed first or designated as the main holder

examples.en: The bank asked the primary account holder to verify which mailing address it should use.
examples.zh: 银行请「主账户持有人」确认应该使用哪个邮寄地址。

examples.en: I checked who was named as the primary account holder in the letter they sent.
examples.zh: 我查了他们寄来的信，看上面把谁列为「主账户持有人」。

words.enDefinition: someone permitted to sign or transact for an account holder

examples.en: The adviser explained what an authorized signer could do under the bank's written terms.
examples.zh: 顾问说明，按银行的书面条款，「授权签字人」可以办理哪些事项。

examples.en: I checked whether the authorized signer was listed separately from the account holder on the form.
examples.zh: 我确认了一下，表格上「授权签字人」和账户持有人是不是分开列的。

words.enDefinition: permission to sign documents or authorize actions for an account

examples.en: I asked what signing authority each holder had under the joint account agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按联名账户协议，每位持有人有怎样的「签字权限」。

examples.en: The bank employee checked the section about signing authority before accepting my form.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员核对了「签字权限」一栏后，才收下我的表格。

words.enDefinition: written instructions identifying who may operate a bank account

examples.en: The bank gave me a copy of the account mandate after I checked the details.
examples.zh: 我核对完资料后，银行给了我一份「账户操作授权书」的副本。

examples.en: The adviser explained which changes would require a new account mandate from the holders.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了哪些变更需要账户持有人提交新的「账户操作授权书」。

collocations: a copy of the account mandate

words.enDefinition: a document allowing another person to act for the holder

examples.en: I asked the bank what a third-party mandate meant before completing the application.
examples.zh: 我填申请之前，先问银行什么是「第三方账户授权书」。

examples.en: The adviser pointed me to the third-party mandate section of the account handbook.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看了账户手册里关于「第三方账户授权书」的那部分。

words.enDefinition: an account used to keep money for future use

examples.en: I opened a savings account for money I had set aside over the summer.
examples.zh: 我开了一个「储蓄账户」，存我暑假攒下的钱。

examples.en: My savings account appeared on a separate page of the bank's online dashboard.
examples.zh: 我的「储蓄账户」显示在银行在线界面的另一个页面上。

collocations: put money in a savings account

words.enDefinition: an account designed for saving money at regular intervals

examples.en: The brochure described a regular savings account in a section about making monthly deposits.
examples.zh: 宣传册在关于每月存款的章节介绍了一款「定期存入型储蓄账户」。

examples.en: I asked how the regular savings account differed from my other account at the branch.
examples.zh: 我向网点询问「定期存入型储蓄账户」和我另一个账户有什么区别。

collocations: terms of a regular savings account

words.enDefinition: a savings account allowing withdrawals without a fixed waiting period

examples.en: The website explained the easy access savings account in a separate section for new customers.
examples.zh: 网站为新客户单列了一节，介绍「灵活支取储蓄账户」。

examples.en: I asked when I could view my easy access savings account in the mobile app.
examples.zh: 我问什么时候能在手机应用里看到我的「灵活支取储蓄账户」。

collocations: open an easy access savings account
offer an easy access savings account
an easy access savings account balance

words.enDefinition: a savings account requiring advance notice before a withdrawal

examples.en: I looked up notice savings account after seeing that phrase in the bank's brochure.
examples.zh: 我在银行宣传册上看到「通知支取储蓄账户」这个词，就查了一下。

examples.en: The notice savings account had a separate document explaining when withdrawals could be made.
examples.zh: 「通知支取储蓄账户」有一份独立文件，说明什么时候可以支取。

collocations: terms of a notice savings account

words.enDefinition: a savings account offering a comparatively high interest rate

examples.en: I asked about the high-yield savings account after seeing it listed on the student portal.
examples.zh: 我在学生平台上看到「高息储蓄账户」后，咨询了相关情况。

examples.en: The account guide listed a high-yield savings account alongside two of the bank's other products.
examples.zh: 账户指南把「高息储蓄账户」和银行另外两款产品列在一起。

collocations: terms of a high-yield savings account

words.enDefinition: a deposit held for a period agreed in advance

examples.en: I checked the date on my fixed-term deposit before writing it into my calendar.
examples.zh: 我查了「固定期限存款」的日期，再把它记到日历里。

examples.en: The bank sent me a separate statement for the fixed-term deposit last month.
examples.zh: 银行上个月单独给我发了一份「固定期限存款」的账单。

words.enDefinition: a US bank savings product for a fixed term

examples.en: I saw certificate of deposit listed among the savings products on the American bank's website.
examples.zh: 我在那家美国银行的网站上看到，「美国定期存单」被列为一种储蓄产品。

examples.en: The bank showed where my certificate of deposit would appear on the account dashboard.
examples.zh: 银行告诉我，我的「定期存单」会在账户界面的哪里显示。

collocations: the maturity date of a certificate of deposit

words.enDefinition: a US deposit account that generally earns interest

examples.en: The bank listed a money market account separately from the fund with a similar name.
examples.zh: 银行把「货币市场存款账户」和名字相近的基金分开列出。

examples.en: I asked what a money market account was when I saw it on the bank's website.
examples.zh: 我在银行网站看到「货币市场存款账户」时，问了它是什么意思。

collocations: terms of a money market account

words.enDefinition: a bank account designed for people who recently graduated

examples.en: My bank wrote to me about a graduate account near the end of my final semester.
examples.zh: 最后一个学期快结束时，银行写信给我介绍「毕业生账户」。

examples.en: I asked when the graduate account would appear after the bank changed my status.
examples.zh: 银行改了我的身份状态后，我问「毕业生账户」什么时候会显示。

collocations: the terms of a graduate account

words.enDefinition: an account for someone not resident in a jurisdiction

examples.en: I asked whether my bank offered a non-resident account after I moved back home.
examples.zh: 我搬回自己的国家后，问银行有没有「非居民账户」。

examples.en: The non-resident account information occupied a separate section of the bank's new customer guide.
examples.zh: 银行的新客户指南单独拿出一节介绍「非居民账户」。

words.enDefinition: an account that can hold more than one currency

examples.en: The website listed which currencies the multi-currency account could hold at that branch.
examples.zh: 网站列出了该网点的「多币种账户」支持哪些币种。

examples.en: I checked whether the multi-currency account showed a separate balance for each supported currency.
examples.zh: 我确认了一下，「多币种账户」是否分别显示每种支持币种的余额。

words.enDefinition: the conditions someone must meet to obtain an account

examples.en: The bank changed the wording about account eligibility before the new semester started.
examples.zh: 开学前，银行修改了有关「账户申请资格」的表述。

examples.en: I asked which page described account eligibility for students arriving from another country.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页说明了留学生的「账户申请资格」。

words.enDefinition: the conditions and documents needed to open an account

examples.en: The local branch listed its account opening requirements in a leaflet for new customers.
examples.zh: 附近的网点在发给新客户的折页上列出了「开户要求」。

examples.en: I asked whether the account opening requirements had changed since the website was last updated.
examples.zh: 我问网站上次更新以来，「开户要求」有没有变。

words.enDefinition: a request asking a bank to open an account

examples.en: My bank account application was still being reviewed when the first semester started.
examples.zh: 第一学期开学时，我的「银行账户申请」还在审核。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the bank account application before closing the browser window.
examples.zh: 关闭浏览器窗口前，我保存了一份「银行账户申请」的副本。

words.enDefinition: documents showing where a person lives or receives mail

examples.en: The teller asked for proof of address after checking the name on my passport.
examples.zh: 柜员核对护照上的姓名后，要求我提供「地址证明」。

examples.en: I checked which documents the branch would accept as proof of address this semester.
examples.zh: 我查了这个学期网点认可哪些材料作「地址证明」。

collocations: documents accepted as proof of address

words.enDefinition: the process of checking that a stated address is accurate

examples.en: The bank said address verification was still in progress after my documents arrived.
examples.zh: 银行说收到我的材料后，「地址核验」仍在进行。

examples.en: I phoned the branch about address verification because my application displayed the old flat number.
examples.zh: 申请页面显示的还是旧公寓门牌号，我就打电话问网点「地址核验」的情况。

words.enDefinition: the place where someone actually lives

examples.en: The bank asked for a residential address and a separate place to send letters.
examples.zh: 银行要求填写「居住地址」，还问了另外收信的地址。

examples.en: I updated my residential address after I moved out of my first student flat.
examples.zh: 我搬出第一套学生公寓后，更新了「居住地址」。

words.enDefinition: the address designated for official letters and notices

examples.en: My correspondence address stayed the same while I spent one semester in another city.
examples.zh: 我到另一个城市学习一学期期间，「通信地址」没有变。

examples.en: The clerk checked that the correspondence address matched the one on my application.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对了「通信地址」，确认它和申请表上的一致。

collocations: send mail to the correspondence address

words.enDefinition: an official identification document containing the holder's photograph

examples.en: The bank employee asked which government-issued photo ID I had brought to the appointment.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员问我赴约时带了哪一种「政府签发的带照证件」。

examples.en: I checked whether the branch accepted my government-issued photo ID before booking a visit.
examples.zh: 约去网点前，我确认了那里是否接受我的「政府签发的带照证件」。

words.enDefinition: checking that someone is who they claim to be

examples.en: The bank sent me to a separate page for identity verification during my application.
examples.zh: 申请时，银行把我引导到一个独立页面做「身份核验」。

examples.en: I asked whether identity verification had finished after the branch received my new documents.
examples.zh: 网点收到了我新交的材料，我就问「身份核验」是否已经完成。

words.enDefinition: verification carried out in person at a bank branch

examples.en: The adviser told me which documents to bring for in-branch verification the following afternoon.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我第二天下午去做「网点现场核验」要带哪些材料。

examples.en: My appointment was for in-branch verification rather than a discussion about different account types.
examples.zh: 我约的是「网点现场核验」，不是咨询不同的账户类型。

words.enDefinition: a review of documents for completeness or accuracy

examples.en: The document check took longer because my name was spelled differently on two forms.
examples.zh: 两张表上我的名字拼法不同，所以「材料查验」耗时更久。

examples.en: The employee returned my paperwork once the document check was complete that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午「材料查验」结束后，工作人员把文件还给了我。

words.enDefinition: the kinds of identification a service recognizes as valid

examples.en: I read the accepted forms of ID before deciding what to take to the branch.
examples.zh: 我先看了「认可的身份证件类型」，再决定去网点要带什么。

examples.en: The bank displayed the accepted forms of ID next to the link for account applications.
examples.zh: 银行在开户申请链接旁列出了「认可的身份证件类型」。

collocations: check the accepted forms of ID
information on accepted forms of ID

words.enDefinition: to take the actual documents rather than copies

examples.en: The appointment email asked me to bring original documents rather than photos on my phone.
examples.zh: 预约邮件让我「携带证件原件」，而不是用手机里的照片。

examples.en: I asked whether to bring original documents to the branch at my next visit.
examples.zh: 我问下次去网点时是否需要「携带证件原件」。

collocations: ask someone to bring original documents
be asked to bring original documents

words.enDefinition: the process of sending a file to a website

examples.en: The website showed a document upload in progress and asked me to wait on that page.
examples.zh: 网站显示正在「上传材料」，让我先留在当前页面。

examples.en: I tried the document upload again after the bank sent me a fresh link.
examples.zh: 银行发来一个新链接后，我又尝试了「上传材料」。

words.enDefinition: a sample signature kept for comparison and verification

examples.en: The bank employee asked for a specimen signature after reviewing my account opening form.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员看过我的开户表后，要求提供「留存签名样本」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could update my specimen signature after changing my surname last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天换姓后，我问能不能更新「留存签名样本」。

collocations: keep a specimen signature on file

words.enDefinition: a bank form recording an authorized person's signature

examples.en: The teller handed me a signature card and explained where I should sign it.
examples.zh: 柜员递给我一张「签名留样卡」，说明要在哪里签名。

examples.en: I asked whether the signature card listed both holders of our new joint account.
examples.zh: 我问「签名留样卡」上是否列了新联名账户的两位持有人。

words.enDefinition: a contract setting out the terms of an account

examples.en: I read the account agreement before asking the banker how to update my contact details.
examples.zh: 我先读了「账户协议」，再问银行工作人员怎么更新联系方式。

examples.en: The bank emailed the account agreement after confirming the type of account I had chosen.
examples.zh: 银行确认了我选的账户类型后，发来了「账户协议」。

collocations: a copy of the account agreement

words.enDefinition: a notice stating that a new account has been opened

examples.en: I looked for the account opening confirmation after the adviser finished checking my details.
examples.zh: 顾问核对完我的资料后，我就查看有没有「开户确认」。

examples.en: The account opening confirmation listed my name and the date the bank registered the account.
examples.zh: 「开户确认」上列出了我的名字和银行登记该账户的日期。

words.enDefinition: information and materials provided to a new customer

examples.en: My bank's welcome pack included a leaflet about how to contact the local branch.
examples.zh: 银行的「新客户资料包」里有一份折页，介绍怎样联系附近的网点。

examples.en: The teller gave me a welcome pack before I left the branch that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午离开网点前，柜员给了我一份「新客户资料包」。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that an application has not been decided

examples.en: The portal showed application pending after the bank received the last document I sent.
examples.zh: 银行收到我最后提交的材料后，平台显示「申请待处理」。

examples.en: I asked the branch what application pending meant for the documents I had already provided.
examples.zh: 我问网点，材料都交了，显示「申请待处理」是什么意思。

collocations: a status message reading application pending

words.enDefinition: the bank's decision to accept a request for an account

examples.en: I received a message about account approval while I was on the bus to class.
examples.zh: 我坐公交去上课时，收到了一条关于「开户获批」的消息。

examples.en: The adviser explained who would contact me once account approval had been recorded in the system.
examples.zh: 顾问说明，系统登记「开户获批」后会由谁联系我。

words.enDefinition: evidence showing whose name is on an account

examples.en: The university asked for proof of account ownership before adding my details to its payment system.
examples.zh: 学校要求提供「账户归属证明」，然后才把我的资料录入付款系统。

examples.en: I asked whether the online letter would be accepted as proof of account ownership.
examples.zh: 我问那封网上信函能不能用作「账户归属证明」。

collocations: documents showing proof of account ownership

words.enDefinition: a letter from a bank confirming account details

examples.en: The bank printed an account confirmation letter after checking the spelling of my name.
examples.zh: 银行核对我姓名的拼写后，打印了一份「账户确认函」。

examples.en: I attached the account confirmation letter to the form requested by the university office.
examples.zh: 我把「账户确认函」附在了学校办公室要求填写的表格后面。

words.enDefinition: a statement the bank has formally confirmed as authentic

examples.en: I asked whether the office wanted a certified bank statement or would accept the online copy.
examples.zh: 我问办公室，需要的是「经银行认证的对账单」，还是网上下载的副本也行。

examples.en: The branch printed the certified bank statement after I confirmed which month I needed.
examples.zh: 我确认了要哪个月的之后，网点打印了「经银行认证的对账单」。

collocations: a copy of the certified bank statement

words.enDefinition: the number that identifies a specific bank account

examples.en: I checked the account number on the letter before entering it on the university form.
examples.zh: 我先核对了信上的「账号」，再把它填到学校表格上。

examples.en: The teller said the account number appeared below my name on the first page.
examples.zh: 柜员说，「账号」在第一页我的名字下方。

words.enDefinition: a number a bank uses to identify a customer

examples.en: The bank said my customer number was different from the number on my account.
examples.zh: 银行说我的「客户编号」和账户上的号码不一样。

examples.en: I found the customer number on the welcome letter the branch had sent me.
examples.zh: 我在网点寄来的欢迎信上找到了「客户编号」。

words.enDefinition: the name that the bank has recorded for an account

examples.en: I checked the name on the account before sending the confirmation letter to the university.
examples.zh: 把确认函发给学校前，我核对了「账户登记姓名」。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether the name on the account matched the document I had brought.
examples.zh: 工作人员问「账户登记姓名」是否与我带来的证件一致。

collocations: check the name on the account
change the name on the account
confirm the name on the account

words.enDefinition: to change information that a bank keeps about an account

examples.en: I logged in to update account details after changing flats at the start of summer.
examples.zh: 初夏换了公寓后，我登录去「更新账户资料」。

examples.en: The bank explained where I could update account details if the mobile app was unavailable.
examples.zh: 银行说明，如果手机应用用不了，我可以去哪里「更新账户资料」。

words.enDefinition: the address already stored in an organization's records

examples.en: The bank sent the letter to the address on file before I reported the move.
examples.zh: 我通知搬家之前，银行把信寄到了「登记在案的地址」。

examples.en: I asked whether the address on file was the same one I had written yesterday.
examples.zh: 我问「登记在案的地址」是不是我昨天填的那个。

words.expression: change your name on the account
words.lemma: change your name on the account
words.enDefinition: to replace the name registered on your bank account
acceptedEnVariants: change your name on the account

examples.en: The form explains how to change your name on the account after a legal name change.
examples.zh: 表格说明，法定姓名变更后如何「变更账户登记姓名」。

examples.en: The adviser said, “You can ask to change your name on the account at the branch.”
examples.zh: 顾问说：“你可以到网点申请「变更账户登记姓名」。”

collocations: ask to change your name on the account
apply to change your name on the account
documents to change your name on the account

words.enDefinition: the span of time covered by an account statement

examples.en: I checked the statement period because the document did not include my last deposit.
examples.zh: 那份文件没列最近一笔存款，我就核对了「对账单涵盖期间」。

examples.en: The statement period was printed directly below my name and mailing address on the first page.
examples.zh: 第一页在我的姓名和邮寄地址正下方印有「对账单涵盖期间」。

collocations: the end of a statement period

words.enDefinition: the date on which a statement is prepared or issued

examples.en: The statement date was one day earlier than the date I downloaded the file.
examples.zh: 「对账单出具日期」比我下载文件的日期早一天。

examples.en: I checked the statement date before deciding whether it was recent enough for the application.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「对账单出具日期」，再判断它是否符合申请对时间的要求。

words.enDefinition: a printed statement showing activity and balances on an account

examples.en: The paper statement arrived at my student flat a week after I requested it.
examples.zh: 申请一周后，「纸质对账单」寄到了我的学生公寓。

examples.en: I asked the teller whether a paper statement could be printed at the branch.
examples.zh: 我问柜员，能不能在网点打印一份「纸质对账单」。

words.enDefinition: a statement provided as a digital document

examples.en: I downloaded the electronic statement after finding the right month in my account dashboard.
examples.zh: 我在账户界面找到正确的月份后，下载了「电子对账单」。

examples.en: The bank sent a message when my electronic statement became available on its website.
examples.zh: 「电子对账单」可以在银行网站查看时，银行发来了消息。

words.enDefinition: how often an account statement is made available

examples.en: I asked the adviser about statement frequency after receiving two statements in one month.
examples.zh: 一个月收到两份对账单后，我向顾问询问了「对账单发送频率」。

examples.en: The app did not let me change statement frequency, so I asked the branch.
examples.zh: 这个应用里改不了「对账单发送频率」，我就咨询了网点。

words.enDefinition: a brief presentation of an account's key information

examples.en: I opened the account summary to check which branch the bank had listed.
examples.zh: 我打开「账户概览」，查看银行登记的是哪个网点。

examples.en: The account summary showed my name, the account type, and the last update date.
examples.zh: 「账户概览」显示了我的姓名、账户类型和最近更新日期。

words.enDefinition: a display name a customer chooses for an account

examples.en: I added an account nickname because both accounts looked identical on the screen.
examples.zh: 两个账户在屏幕上看起来一模一样，我就加了一个「账户自定义名称」。

examples.en: The account nickname changed on my dashboard after I saved the new settings.
examples.zh: 保存新设置后，界面上的「账户自定义名称」变了。

words.enDefinition: an application for using banking services on a phone

examples.en: I could see my new account in the mobile banking app the following day.
examples.zh: 第二天，我就在「手机银行应用」里看到了新账户。

examples.en: The teller explained where the account settings appeared in the mobile banking app.
examples.zh: 柜员解释了账户设置在「手机银行应用」里的哪个位置。

collocations: sign in to the mobile banking app
an alert from the mobile banking app

words.enDefinition: to enroll to use a bank's services through the internet

examples.en: I asked whether I could register for online banking before receiving the welcome letter.
examples.zh: 我问收到银行欢迎信之前能不能「注册网上银行」。

examples.en: The bank sent a leaflet explaining how to register for online banking from home.
examples.zh: 银行发来一张折页，介绍怎么在家「注册网上银行」。

collocations: help someone register for online banking
decide to register for online banking
instructions to register for online banking

words.enDefinition: the identifier used to sign into online banking

examples.en: The representative asked whether I could still remember my online banking ID after the move.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我，搬家后是否还记得自己的「网银用户识别号」。

examples.en: I checked the welcome letter for my online banking ID while waiting at the branch.
examples.zh: 我在网点等候时，翻查了欢迎信里的「网银用户识别号」。

words.enDefinition: signing in using a physical feature such as a fingerprint

examples.en: I found biometric sign-in under account settings after updating the bank's app.
examples.zh: 更新银行应用后，我在账户设置里找到了「生物识别登录」。

examples.en: The adviser explained the phrase biometric sign-in when I asked about the welcome leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问起欢迎折页时，顾问解释了「生物识别登录」这个词。

words.enDefinition: to set a new password for online banking access

examples.en: The guide explains where to reset your online banking password if you forget it.
examples.zh: 指南说明忘记密码后，可以在哪里「重设网银密码」。

examples.en: The adviser said, “You can reset your online banking password through the official app.”
examples.zh: 顾问说：“你可以通过官方应用「重设网银密码」。”

collocations: an option to reset your online banking password
a page to reset your online banking password
ask how to reset your online banking password

words.enDefinition: a notification that funds have fallen below a level

examples.en: I received a low balance alert while looking up the dates of my next payments.
examples.zh: 我查询接下来几笔款项的日期时，收到了「余额过低提醒」。

examples.en: The bank explained what would trigger a low balance alert on this account.
examples.zh: 银行说明了这个账户在什么情况下会触发「余额过低提醒」。

collocations: turn off a low balance alert

words.enDefinition: an account setting about which documents arrive by mail

examples.en: I checked my mailing preference after the first statement went to my old address.
examples.zh: 第一份对账单寄到旧地址后，我查看了自己的「邮寄偏好设置」。

examples.en: The bank asked us to confirm our mailing preference before the new account opened.
examples.zh: 新账户开通前，银行请我们确认「邮寄偏好设置」。

words.enDefinition: the category of account a customer holds or requests

examples.en: I selected the wrong account type and asked the adviser how to correct it.
examples.zh: 我选错了「账户类型」，便问顾问怎么改。

examples.en: I checked the account type at the top of the page before submitting my application.
examples.zh: 提交申请前，我核对了页面顶部的「账户类型」。

words.enDefinition: an account intended for personal rather than business use

examples.en: The form asked whether I needed a personal account or an account for a business.
examples.zh: 表格问我需要的是「个人用途账户」，还是企业用的账户。

examples.en: I checked whether the branch could print a statement for my personal account that day.
examples.zh: 我问网点当天能不能打印我「个人用途账户」的对账单。

collocations: a statement for a personal account

words.enDefinition: the services and characteristics included with a particular account

examples.en: The adviser explained the account features I had circled in the product leaflet.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了我在产品折页上圈出的几项「账户功能」。

examples.en: I copied the account features into my notes before discussing them with my roommate.
examples.zh: 和室友讨论之前，我把「账户功能」抄到了笔记上。

words.enDefinition: the date on which an account was first opened

examples.en: I confirmed the account opening date before asking the branch for a signed letter.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「开户日期」，再向网点申请一份签字信函。

examples.en: The account opening date appeared under my name on the bank's confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 银行确认函上，我名字的下方写着「开户日期」。

collocations: proof of the account opening date

words.enDefinition: the recorded state of an account, such as active or closed

examples.en: The adviser checked the account status before trying to open the old statements.
examples.zh: 顾问先核对了「账户状态」，再试着打开旧对账单。

examples.en: I could see the account status next to the name on the banking dashboard.
examples.zh: 我能在银行页面上看到姓名旁边的「账户状态」。

words.enDefinition: an account that is open and in use

examples.en: The help page said that an active account would appear in the main list.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说，「在用账户」会显示在主列表里。

examples.en: I asked whether the account listed in my records was still an active account.
examples.zh: 我问记录里列的那个账户是不是仍为「在用账户」。

words.enDefinition: an account classified as unused for a sustained period

examples.en: The bank described my old account as a dormant account after years without activity.
examples.zh: 账户多年没有动过，银行把它归为「休眠账户」。

examples.en: I called the branch to ask what a dormant account meant in their notice.
examples.zh: 我打电话给网点，问通知里说的「休眠账户」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a message about an account becoming or being classed dormant

examples.en: I opened the dormancy notice and checked which account the bank was referring to.
examples.zh: 我打开「账户休眠通知」，看银行说的是哪个账户。

examples.en: The dormancy notice had been sent to the address I used as a student.
examples.zh: 「账户休眠通知」寄到了我上学时用的地址。

words.enDefinition: to restore an unused account to active status

examples.en: I went to the branch to ask how to reactivate an account opened years ago.
examples.zh: 我去网点问，多年前开的账户怎样能「重新激活账户」。

examples.en: The banker explained which form to use to reactivate an account that had become dormant.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员说明，账户休眠后要用哪张表「重新激活账户」。

collocations: ask how to reactivate an account

words.enDefinition: a limit on what can be done with an account

examples.en: I asked whether the account restriction applied to viewing statements or only certain services.
examples.zh: 我问「账户操作限制」会影响查看对账单，还是只影响某些服务。

examples.en: The bank sent an email explaining why there was an account restriction on my profile.
examples.zh: 银行发邮件说明，我的账户资料上为什么有「账户操作限制」。

words.enDefinition: a block preventing some or all use of an account

examples.en: The branch told me whom to contact regarding the account freeze mentioned in the letter.
examples.zh: 网点告诉我，信上提到的「账户冻结」该联系谁。

examples.en: I asked which dates were covered by the account freeze shown on my dashboard.
examples.zh: 我问页面上显示的「账户冻结」涉及哪段日期。

words.enDefinition: to restore use of a frozen bank account

examples.en: I asked which team could unfreeze an account after reviewing the documents already submitted.
examples.zh: 我问，哪个团队审核已提交的材料后可以「解除账户冻结」。

examples.en: The letter explained whom to contact to unfreeze an account after the review was complete.
examples.zh: 信里说明了审核结束后，可以找谁「解除账户冻结」。

collocations: ask how to unfreeze an account
review a request to unfreeze an account

words.enDefinition: the process of permanently ending a bank account

examples.en: I asked about account closure because I was leaving the university at the end of term.
examples.zh: 我学期结束后就要离开学校，所以咨询了「账户注销」。

examples.en: The bank sent information about account closure to the email address I had confirmed.
examples.zh: 银行把有关「账户注销」的信息发到了我确认过的邮箱。

words.enDefinition: to end a bank account so it cannot be used

examples.en: I asked whether I could close an account at the branch next to campus.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在校区旁边的网点「注销账户」。

examples.en: The help page explained how to close an account without visiting my original branch.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明了不去原网点也可以怎样「注销账户」。

words.enDefinition: a form used to request the closing of an account

examples.en: I checked my signature on the account closure form before returning it to the teller.
examples.zh: 把「销户申请表」交回柜员前，我核对了自己的签名。

examples.en: The account closure form asked where the bank should send the final confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 「销户申请表」询问银行应把最终确认函寄到哪里。

words.enDefinition: a notice stating that an account has been closed

examples.en: The bank emailed my account closure confirmation the week after I left my student flat.
examples.zh: 搬出学生公寓一周后，银行发邮件给了我「销户确认」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the account closure confirmation with my other banking records.
examples.zh: 我保存了一份「销户确认」，和其他银行记录放在一起。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money left in an account

examples.en: I asked what would happen to the remaining balance if I closed the account.
examples.zh: 我问，销户后账户的「账户余款」会怎么处理。

examples.en: The banker pointed out the remaining balance before asking me to check the statement.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员先指给我看了「账户余款」，再请我核对对账单。

words.enDefinition: an account amount showing neither funds nor money owed

examples.en: The app showed a zero balance after the account had been opened for me.
examples.zh: 银行给我开好账户后，应用显示「余额为零」。

examples.en: I asked why my older statement showed a zero balance on the last day.
examples.zh: 我问较早的一份对账单为什么显示最后一天「余额为零」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount a particular account requires or specifies

examples.en: The bank booklet listed a minimum balance for the account I asked about.
examples.zh: 银行小册子列出了我询问的那个账户的「最低余额」。

examples.en: I checked whether the minimum balance was described on the same page as the fees.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，「最低余额」和费用是不是在同一页上说明的。

words.enDefinition: the smallest initial amount required to fund an account

examples.en: I asked what minimum opening deposit the bank listed for its basic account.
examples.zh: 我问银行的基础账户规定的「最低开户存款金额」是多少。

examples.en: The brochure showed the minimum opening deposit separately from monthly account fees.
examples.zh: 宣传册把「最低开户存款金额」和每月账户费用分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a charge billed each month for maintaining an account

examples.en: I asked where the monthly maintenance fee would appear on my bank statement.
examples.zh: 我问「月账户管理费」会出现在银行对账单的哪里。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the monthly maintenance fee listed under this account type.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指了该账户类型下列出的「月账户管理费」。

collocations: a monthly maintenance fee on an account

words.enDefinition: to decide not to collect a monthly account charge

examples.en: I asked whether the bank would waive the monthly fee for my student account.
examples.zh: 我问银行会不会给我的学生账户「免收月费」。

examples.en: The letter explained when the bank might waive the monthly fee for this account.
examples.zh: 信里说明了这类账户在什么情况下可能「免收月费」。

collocations: agree to waive the monthly fee
ask the bank to waive the monthly fee
offer to waive the monthly fee

words.enDefinition: a balance level used to trigger a rule or alert

examples.en: I chose a balance threshold while changing when the app would send me alerts.
examples.zh: 我修改应用发送提醒的时间和条件时，选定了一个「余额阈值」。

examples.en: The bank explained how to tell which balance threshold was active on my account.
examples.zh: 银行说明了如何查看我的账户当前使用哪个「余额阈值」。

words.enDefinition: messages triggered by certain events on a bank account

examples.en: I received account alerts by email while my phone was being repaired that week.
examples.zh: 那周手机在维修，我通过邮件接收「账户提醒」。

examples.en: The app listed which account alerts I could turn on for my new account.
examples.zh: 应用列出了我的新账户可以开启哪些「账户提醒」。

words.enDefinition: the balance reflecting transactions already officially recorded

examples.en: I asked why the ledger balance differed from what I could use that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问「账面余额」为什么和当天下午能用的钱不一样。

examples.en: The adviser showed me the ledger balance separately from the amount available to withdraw.
examples.zh: 顾问把「账面余额」和可提取金额分别指给我看。

words.enDefinition: transactions and other recorded events on a bank account

examples.en: I reviewed recent account activity before asking why two entries had the same date.
examples.zh: 我先查看了近期的「账户活动」，再问为什么有两条记录日期相同。

examples.en: The bank app showed account activity in a separate section from my current settings.
examples.zh: 银行应用把「账户活动」和现有设置分别放在不同的栏目里。

words.enDefinition: the balance shown on an account statement for a period

examples.en: I compared the statement balance with the amount shown in the app that morning.
examples.zh: 我把「对账单余额」和当天上午应用显示的金额比了一下。

examples.en: The teller pointed to the statement balance on the last page of the document.
examples.zh: 柜员指给我看文件最后一页上的「对账单余额」。

words.enDefinition: the times when a bank branch is open

examples.en: I checked branch hours before walking to the bank after my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午上完课走去银行前，我先查了「网点营业时间」。

examples.en: The notice listed different branch hours during the university break in December.
examples.zh: 告示列出了十二月学校放假期间不同的「网点营业时间」。

words.enDefinition: a UK term for an officially designated public holiday

examples.en: The Bristol branch was closed for a bank holiday, so I went back the following morning.
examples.zh: 布里斯托尔的网点因「英国公众假日」没有营业，我第二天早上又去了一趟。

examples.en: The website showed revised opening times for the bank holiday at the start of May.
examples.zh: 网站上公布了五月初「英国公众假日」调整后的营业时间。

collocations: opening hours on a bank holiday

words.enDefinition: an account connected to another account or service

examples.en: The clerk asked me which linked account had the address I wanted to update.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我，想更新的地址在哪个「关联账户」上。

examples.en: I checked the last digits of the linked account before removing it from the app.
examples.zh: 把「关联账户」从应用中移除之前，我核对了它的尾号。

words.enDefinition: an account held at a different financial institution

examples.en: The app asked which institution held the external account that I wanted to view.
examples.zh: 应用问我，想查看的那个「外部账户」开在哪家机构。

examples.en: I could see the external account separately from accounts held at my new bank.
examples.zh: 我看到「外部账户」和新银行里的账户是分开显示的。

collocations: an external account at another bank

words.enDefinition: to remove an existing connection to an account

examples.en: I asked how to unlink an account from the dashboard after changing my banking profile.
examples.zh: 我改了银行资料后，问怎样在页面上「解除账户关联」。

examples.en: The support page explains where to unlink an account that you no longer use.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明，可以在哪里为不再使用的账户「解除账户关联」。

collocations: ask how to unlink an account
an option to unlink an account

words.enDefinition: a service helping move existing banking arrangements to another account

examples.en: I asked whether the bank's account switching service could handle the type of account I had.
examples.zh: 我问银行的「换户服务」能不能办理我这种账户。

examples.en: The branch gave me a leaflet explaining how its account switching service works.
examples.zh: 网点给我一张折页，介绍它的「换户服务」流程。

collocations: information about an account switching service

words.enDefinition: to start using a different bank account instead

examples.en: I decided to switch bank accounts after moving to a different part of the city.
examples.zh: 搬到这座城市的另一个区域后，我决定「更换银行账户」。

examples.en: The adviser asked why I wanted to switch bank accounts before explaining the paperwork.
examples.zh: 顾问问我为什么想「更换银行账户」，然后解释要填哪些文件。

words.enDefinition: to move an existing account to a different account category

examples.en: The branch explained how to change the account type after my student status ended.
examples.zh: 网点解释了学生身份结束后怎样「变更账户类型」。

examples.en: I asked if I could change the account type without getting a new account number.
examples.zh: 我问是否能在保留原账号的情况下「变更账户类型」。

collocations: ask to change the account type
agree to change the account type
apply to change the account type

words.enDefinition: a bank letter describing a customer's banking relationship

examples.en: I asked for a bank reference letter after the housing office requested one from me.
examples.zh: 住房办公室要求出示一份，我就申请了「银行资信函」。

examples.en: The banker explained which details could appear in the bank reference letter that I needed.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员说明了我需要的「银行资信函」上可以写哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: documents showing that someone has access to a stated amount

examples.en: The university asked for proof of funds before processing my application for the exchange program.
examples.zh: 学校要求先提供「资金证明」，才受理我的交换项目申请。

examples.en: I asked whether the bank could issue a letter to use as proof of funds.
examples.zh: 我问银行能不能开一封信作为「资金证明」。

collocations: a letter showing proof of funds

words.enDefinition: a bank-issued document certifying the balance of an account

examples.en: I asked whether the balance certificate could show the amount on a specific date.
examples.zh: 我问「存款余额证明」能不能显示某个指定日期的余额。

examples.en: The bank supplied a balance certificate separately from my regular monthly statement that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午，银行在常规月度对账单之外，单独给了我一份「存款余额证明」。

words.enDefinition: a booklet recording deposits and withdrawals for a savings account

examples.en: My family still uses a passbook for a savings account at their local branch.
examples.zh: 我家还在用「存折」记录当地网点的一个储蓄账户。

examples.en: I asked the teller whether the passbook needed to be brought in for updating.
examples.zh: 我问柜员，更新记录时是不是需要把「存折」带到网点。

words.enDefinition: money paid into an account in physical notes or coins

examples.en: I asked when the cash deposit would appear on my account after visiting the branch.
examples.zh: 我去过网点后，问「现金存款」什么时候会显示在账户上。

examples.en: The teller counted the cash deposit before recording it on my savings account.
examples.zh: 柜员先清点了「现金存款」，再登记进我的储蓄账户。

collocations: a cash deposit at a branch

words.enDefinition: a form listing details of money paid into an account

examples.en: The teller handed back my deposit slip after correcting the date I had written.
examples.zh: 柜员改正我填的日期后，把「存款单」还给了我。

examples.en: I checked the account number on the deposit slip before giving it to the teller.
examples.zh: 把「存款单」交给柜员之前，我核对了上面的账号。

collocations: a copy of the deposit slip

words.enDefinition: the decision to stop operating at a bank branch

examples.en: The notice gave the date of the branch closure and listed the nearest remaining office.
examples.zh: 通知给出了「银行网点关闭」的日期，还列出了最近仍营业的网点。

examples.en: I had a question about old statements after reading the letter about the branch closure.
examples.zh: 看到关于「银行网点关闭」的信后，我有个关于旧对账单的问题。
